verses.1: To be destroyed by the music of David.
verses.2: I heard God’s voice; I listened attentively. My prayers were heard.
verses.3: From every corner of the earth, I will call to you in my heart, in the darkness of night. Please save me from me.
verses.4: For you have protected me from the great power of evil.
verses.5: Your wings hide the secrets of eternity in their secrecy.
verses.6: For you are God; you have heard my prayer. You have given me a son to glorify your name.
verses.7: For days after the king’s reign, his years continued like days and nights.
verses.8: There will be a time in eternity when grace and truth will reign before God.
verses.9: May your name be praised forever, so that I may be safe from harm day after day.
